subject.title: autoreview: secret-scanner false positives on identifier and member-expression values (e.g. `apiSecret: ctx.cloudinary.apiSecret`)

question: Does current main pass all three reported reference forms while still rejecting literal or executable secret-like values, and can the fixing commit's release containment be confirmed?
rationale: The implementation and merged fix strongly indicate resolution, but the repository's implemented-on-main close policy requires focused behavior confirmation and release or current-main-only provenance.

options.title: Verify and close
options.body: Run the focused safe-reference and negative cases, confirm commit containment, then close as implemented if they pass.

options.title: Keep for regression work
options.body: Keep the issue open if any reported form still fails or an unsafe expression is newly accepted, and add narrowly scoped coverage.

recommendation.title: Verify and close
recommendation.body: Run the focused safe-reference and negative cases, confirm commit containment, then close as implemented if they pass.
